name: Enterprise Deep Research
description: Salesforce's multi-agent deep-research system with a planning agent, specialised search agents and live user steering.
whatItDoes: EDR decomposes a research question, gathers evidence from general web, academic, GitHub and LinkedIn searches, and writes a report, while the user can redirect it mid-run. It targets enterprise analytics and research use.
howItWorks: A master planning agent assigns work to search agents and tool integrations (including MCP), with a reflection step that tracks knowledge gaps. A FastAPI backend serves a React frontend; a benchmark script runs it from the command line.

requirements.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
requirements.description: Or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, GROQ_API_KEY, SAMBNOVA_API_KEY or Google Cloud, per LLM_PROVIDER

install: cd ai-research-assistant && npm install && npm run build && cd ..
